text:
dan: heads up — ap-east warmpool spikes, new nodes stuck at BOOTSTRAP for ~10m
emma: looking at bootstrap logs: `KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied` and `connect to keystore-proxy:443 timed out`
rafa: did we push any privnet or firewall changes in ap-east overnight?
priya: eng-security did a small firewall pruning (egress-lockdown v2) that removed permissive 0.0.0.0/0 for host-level egress; intended to force all keystore traffic through the regional proxy pool
dan: suspects: proxy pool didn't repoint in time (DNS stale) so bootstrap attempted direct keystore endpoint IPs which are now blocked
guard-bot: policy-deploy egress-lockdown v2 -> ap-east at 2026-04-03T01:12Z by eng-security
emma: sample excerpt:
```
Apr 03 01:45:12 bootstrap error: dial tcp 10.11.22.33:443: i/o timeout
Apr 03 01:45:12 bootstrap error: decrypt failed: AccessDenied KMS:Decrypt condition aws:SourceVpc mismatch
```
rafa: mitigation options: (A) add temp allow rule for the observed keystore IPs, (B) revert egress-lockdown in ap-east, (C) update bootstrap to honor proxy env var faster. prefer A for minimal blast radius
priya: security note: if we allow IPs, need a 20m TTL, `x-temp-audit: warmpool-ap-east-0403` tag on requests, and SIEM watchlist enabled
dan: I'll open temporary allow and run 3-node canary. posting IPs below and scheduling automated revert
emma: canary 1 succeeded (node -> Ready). canary 3/3 done, warmpool warming back up
rafa: postmortem items: (1) ensure proxy pool DNS/route update is part of egress rollout checklist, (2) have bootstrap prefer proxy via `HTTP_PROXY` env early in bootstrap, (3) add a unit test simulating egress pruning
priya: approved emergency allowlist for 20m with audit tag. will follow audit logs and revoke if anything odd
guard-bot: incident INC-20260403-ap-east-warmpool created, assignees=eng-ml,eng-security, status=mitigated, followup=postmortem-20260404
